q: Have you not seen the person
who denies the Day of Reckoning?
v.s: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
v.c: Have you seen the one who denies the ˹final˺ Judgment?

q: He is the one who pushes the orphan away
v.s: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
v.c: That is the one who repulses the orphan,

v.s: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
v.c: and does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

q: Destruction be for those performers of salaah
(those) Muslims who ought to be performing salaah)...
v.s: So woe to those who pray
v.c: So woe to those ˹hypocrites˺ who pray

v.s: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
v.c: yet are unmindful of their prayers;

q: (when they do any good deed like performing salaah,)
v.s: Those who make show [of their deeds]

q: (are so miserly that far from spending in charity and zakaah, they)
(of common use that would cause them no loss).
v.c: and refuse to give ˹even the simplest˺ aid.
